recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No current FHIR core source edit is needed unless a future work-group decision changes Bundle.type batch semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-18526 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Feed change request from STU3 asking to clarify that batch entries are independent by changing the batch wording from a group of actions to a group of independent actions.
initial_application: No separate FHIR-18526-tagged source commit was found. The Jira comment says the text had already been fixed, and the matching earlier source application is FHIR-17091 commit f966cc2f53ee0413b8b60d8fada314d615cb9bc0, which changed the Bundle batch definition to independent actions.
additional_context: FHIR-17091 is a Published/Persuasive with Modification issue for the same Bundle.type batch wording. In the current build, source/fhir.ini actively lists bundle=Bundle and source/bundle/codesystem-bundle-type.xml contains the active Bundle Type CodeSystem. Searches found no Confluence references or substantive Zulip evidence conflicting with the current wording.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/bundle/codesystem-bundle-type.xml already defines the batch code as a set of actions processed by a server as a group of independent actions, and the stale old phrase was not found in current source.
